[[File:Pressure.png|right|thumb|A typical pressure.]]
'''Pressures''' were rigid and reinforced domes used to protect [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] and corporate interest on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. Ranging in size from twenty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in diameter to over one hundred meters, they were either geodesic or hemispherical in shape. Pressures were made of either [[Duralumin/Legends|duralumin]] or [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]].
